title: Aspire Finixx Pod Tank 2ml
description: The Aspire Finixx Tank is a sleek and innovative pod tank designed to deliver exceptional flavour and vapour production. Built to complement the Aspire Finixx Pod Kit, this tank combines a stylish design with advanced functionality, making it a standout choice for sub-ohm vapers. Constructed with food-grade Nylon (PA12) and stainless steel, the Finixx Tank offers enhanced heat resistance and durability for a safer and more stable vaping experience. It features a 2ml e-liquid capacity, TPD-compliant, and employs a convenient bottom-filling system for quick and mess-free refills. The Finixx Tank is compatible with Aspire’s high-performance BP coils, including the 0.3Ω and 0.17Ω mesh coils (both included), specially engineered for massive cloud production and rich, intense flavour. With its precise bottom adjustable airflow, the Finixx Tank allows you to fine-tune your draw to achieve your ideal vaping style, whether you prefer an airy DL (Direct-to-Lung) hit or a more restricted draw. Designed for use with the Finixx Kit or any 510-compatible device, the Aspire Finixx Tank is perfect for vapers seeking style, versatility, and performance. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
